ingredients: Important information Safety Information For external use only. Do not ingest. Avoid contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children and pets. For shower use only. Not a bath bomb—do not place in bathwater or submerge. Can be used while showering in a bathtub, but not as a bath bomb. Ingredients Sodium Carbonate, Citric Acid, Sodium Sesquicarbonate, Dextrose, PEG-180, Menthol, Fragrance, Essential Oils Directions 1. Basic use: Remove the wrapper and use one tablet per shower. Place it on the shower floor, or on the tub floor while showering in a bathtub, away from the direct water stream where it can receive light splashes. Do not submerge in bathwater or use as a bath bomb. 2. Adjust scent & dissolving speed: Placement controls activation. For a stronger, faster fragrance release, move the tablet gradually closer to light splashes. For a slower release, keep it farther from the water. Do not place it directly under heavy running water, which can make it dissolve faster. 3. Shower conditions & duration: Warm steam helps disperse the aroma through the shower. Fragrance strength and dissolving time vary with water flow, placement, shower size and ventilation; smaller enclosed showers may feel stronger, while large or highly ventilated showers may feel more subtle. Each tablet is intended for one shower. 4. Storage & care: Keep unused tablets individually wrapped and dry until use. Store in a cool, dry place away from water and bathroom humidity to help preserve the tablet and fragrance. Do not unwrap until ready to use. 5. Safety: For external shower use only. Avoid direct contact with skin and eyes. Do not ingest. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. People sensitive to fragrance, essential oils or menthol should review the ingredient list before use. The Perfect Self-Care Gift: Give someone a spa moment at home. These shower bombs make a thoughtful gift for birthdays, bridesmaids, teachers, college care packages, moms, wives, teens, women, men, and anyone who deserves a little more self-care.

Made in USA with Natural Essential Oils: Thoughtfully crafted with cruelty-free ingredients and pleasantly strong fragrances, these shower pods bring an indulgent aromatherapy experience and premium self-care into your home.

Relax, Unwind & Recharge: Turn bath steamers into a home-spa ritual for mind & body. Shower the stress away, enjoy daily serenity, unwind in the evening, or start your day with a great mood, energy and an uplifting aroma.

Create Your Own Home Spa: Place one shower fizzy in the corner, away from direct water. Light splashes activate and slowly dissolve the tablet, while warm steam helps disperse its aroma. Breathe deeply and enjoy an easy aromatherapy spa at home.
